description.en: Floating rosettes have trumpet-shaped leaves with inflated basal regions and attached roots.
description.zh: 浮生莲座具喇叭状叶、膨大基区及相连根。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Cobbania hickeyi; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Cobbania hickeyi 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Three-dimensional funnel leaves with basal pouches differ from the flatter sessile leaves of Limnobiophyllum.
distinctness.zh: 带基部囊的立体漏斗叶区别于Limnobiophyllum较平无柄叶。

modeling_brief.en: Use cupped radial blades and clear basal pouches above a root bundle; exclude unattached putative flowers.
modeling_brief.zh: 用杯状放射叶片、明显基囊及下方根束建形，排除未相连的推测花。

uncertainty: Reproductive organs associated with the genus are not securely attached to these rosettes.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.
